_note: Campaign ledger. Starts EMPTY by design. A row may be added only from an authorized first-party Amazon Associates report (Associates Central > Reports) or from the owner's own first-party analytics export. Never estimate, backfill, or infer a value: leave a field null and it renders as blank. Every row needs a timestamp and a provenance string that names the exact report and the date it was exported.

schema.timestamp: ISO-8601 date-time the figure was observed or exported (UTC)
schema.source: Exact report or system name, e.g. 'Associates Central > Reports > Earnings'
schema.eligible_sessions: number from the first-party report, or null
schema.clicks: number from the first-party report, or null
schema.reported_orders: number from the first-party report, or null
schema.provenance: file name or URL of the export/screenshot kept by the owner, plus export date. Required.
